items.title: Qantas cuts domestic flights and raises fares as fuel costs blow out
items.description: Qantas will cut domestic flights due to higher fuel costs and the uncertainty of the Middle East war, as it flags as much as $800 million in extra fuel costs.

items.title: Live: US accuses Iran of 'economic terrorism' over Strait of Hormuz obstruction as blockade begins
items.description: US Vice-President JD Vance accuses the Iranian government of engaging in "economic terrorism" by blocking traffic through the Strait of Hormuz as the US Navy begins its blockade of the key shipping waterway. Follow live.

items.title: Palestinian groups take Australia to court over Israel arms exports
items.description: A group of Palestinian human rights organisations launch legal action against the defence minister seeking transparency over Australia's arms exports to Israel.

items.title: Breaking: WA government says it has secured 4 million litres of diesel
items.description: Four million litres of diesel is set to arrive in Western Australia "in the coming weeks" as part of a strategic stockpile to address acute, localised fuel shortages across the state.

items.title: Live: Business confidence crashes to lowest level since April 2020
items.description: The outbreak of the war in the Middle East saw business confidence post its second-largest monthly fall on record, a NAB survey found. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Prince Harry and Meghan kick off Australia visit with stop at Melbourne hospital
items.description: The Duke and Duchess of Sussex have begun their multi-day visit to Australia in Melbourne, meeting with patients at a children's hospital.

items.title: Stagflation is a 'central banker's nightmare', says RBA deputy governor
items.description: RBA deputy governor Andrew Hauser says stagflation is a "central banker's nightmare" and the coming months will be challenging for Australia.

items.title: Safety alert issued amid explosion of illegal peptide use
items.description: The medicines regulator issues a health alert about the risks of using unregulated peptides amid a surge in the use of potentially unsafe injectables.

items.title: 'Make a noise': The ordinary people who took their case to our highest court
items.description: From love and freedom to native title and the right to vote, these are some of the High Court cases that have helped define our nation, and the ordinary people behind them.

items.title: How the AFL's gamble with conflict of interest concerns didn't pay off
items.description: The AFL gambled that concerns over a conflict of interest with one of its umpires wouldn't be an issue, but that call has come back to bite them — and it's not the umpire's fault.

items.title: Trump's 'AI Jesus' post sparks backlash as pope responds to attack
items.description: Donald Trump is criticised by religious sections of his supporter base after publishing, then deleting, the image, but the US president says: "I thought it was me as a doctor."

items.title: Man accused of 'river to the sea' offence tells court he wants to 'plead insanity'
items.description: Jim Dowling is charged with one count of publicly displaying a prohibited expression after displaying a sign reading "from the river to the sea, Brisbane will be free of Boeing."

items.title: Man charged after Molotov cocktail attack on OpenAI CEO's home
items.description: A man accused of throwing a Molotov cocktail at the home of OpenAI's CEO is charged with attempted murder. Authorities say he had written about AI's purported risk to humanity and "our impending extinction".

items.title: INXS is out, Phil Collins in as Rock & Roll Hall of Fame 2026 inductees announced
items.description: INXS has missed out on landing a place in the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame with 2026 inductees including Phil Collins, Queen Latifah and Fela Kuti.

items.title: How I've learnt to embrace the new normal of only having one breast
items.description: I decided to keep my healthy breast, opting against reconstruction. It means I'm now what's known in the community as a uniboober.

items.title: Kitty Flanagan and Anne Edmonds create comedy chaos in new show
items.description: Plus Nicole Kidman is an Aussie wrestler in Margo's Got Money Troubles, Baby Reindeer's Richard Gadd returns, and the reboots keep on coming with Malcolm in the Middle.

items.title: Giant echidna fossil rewrites understanding of Victoria's prehistoric past
items.description: A fossil hidden in a museum collection for 119 years has revealed giant echidnas once roamed Victoria's east, filling a major gap in Australia's prehistoric record.

items.title: New ministers appointed to Victorian cabinet after resignations
items.description: Four new ministers have been promoted to cabinet unopposed at a meeting of Labor MPs at Victorian parliament this morning.

items.title: Prime minister leads tributes after death of NT's first female senator
items.description: A former Arnhem Land schoolteacher who blazed a trail as the Northern Territory’s first female senator, Trish Crossin, has died at age 70.

items.title: Flinders Island man fatally struck by police car consumed '18 handles of beer'
items.description: A coroner dismisses an inquest application from the wife of a Flinders Island man who was fatally struck by a police car after he had a night out at a local pub and left on foot.

items.title: Tornado forces Wallaroos to take refuge inside US hotel
items.description: The Wallaroos' preparations for the Pacific Four Series are dealt an unexpected blow as a warning alarm sounds inside the team hotel in Kansas City.

items.title: Beijing is shifting its Taiwan strategy. Here is why
items.description: It began with a dish once served to Nixon in 1972. Now Beijing is using the same stage to reshape the Taiwan question. China is advancing a slower strategy: using economic incentives and political engagement to influence Taiwan's future.

items.title: Debunking four myths about Australia's fuel crisis
items.description: If you listen to increasingly shrill calls, it is time to rebuild our oil industry. While the sentiments might be well-meant, a few unfortunate facts have been overlooked.

items.title: Roblox to launch accounts for children after grooming claims
items.description: Roblox will launch restricted accounts for children and teenagers, two months after being put on notice by the government over reports children were being groomed on the platform.

items.title: Alleged intruder denies Islamophobic attack at community dinner
items.description: Police say if there is sufficient evidence, a man accused of attacking people at a community dinner could be charged under hate speech laws.
